adaptation.960x540: Positions and regions scale to 75 percent; body text keeps a legible floor; map retains at least 310 px minimum height. Dense descriptions scroll within their box. Main current node and lower-branch keyboard targets keep a safe left inset clear of the task paper.
adaptation.1920x1080: Positions and regions scale to 150 percent; body fonts capped at 135 percent; map remains a continuously draggable canvas.
adaptation.ownership: Shared chrome arranges the regions; world and route modules supply data and actions without changing campaign semantics.
adaptation.overlay_note: Right route choices overlay the full map canvas and shrink to their content; the primary action follows the choices with a 16 px baseline gap. Keyboard-focused map markers are kept clear of both the right choices and lower-left paper.

runtime_fields.phase: nodes[data.current].segment; large phase number, current segment name and six noninteractive progress marks; never turns
runtime_fields.presenter: first configured living female companion, otherwise JIA; no unowned presenter
runtime_fields.party: JIA + actual two auxiliary slots, independent HP/MP, real level and death flags
runtime_fields.world_status: owned companions excluding JIA, entered pool, completed battle node count; no completion percentage
runtime_fields.route_choices: real available nodes and state_for/event/battle availability; inspecting never chooses the node
